text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month, nine-month, and 12-month treasury bills edged down while 18-month bills stayed the same from the last sales, the central bank said on Thursday.

Six-month bills eased to 20.15 percent from 20.17 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 27.71 percent from 27.73 percent, 12-month bills slimmed down to 29.99 from 30.04 percent, and 18-month bills remained steady 32.53 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 18.50 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 17.23 million UAH 6.06 million UAH
Actual amount raised 15.66 million UAH 5.50 million UAH
The central bank sold 172,300 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 22.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 16.00 million UAH 27.30 million UAH
Amount sold 12.67 million UAH 14.61 million UAH
Actual amount raised 10.49 million UAH 12.10 million UAH
The central bank sold 126,672 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 22.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 47.50 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 47.50 million UAH 87.13 million UAH
Actual amount raised 36.57 million UAH 67.05 million UAH
The central bank sold 475,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 22.
The results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 6.46 million UAH 14.08 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.34 million UAH 9.47 million UAH
The central bank sold 64,565 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 22.
